titel: Road to Trump's Transportation Secretary | KMP Ep.53

einzeiler: Sean and Rachel Duffy on family life, reality TV origins, and government modernization.
kurzfassung: Sean and Rachel Duffy discuss their journey from meeting on reality television to raising nine children and serving in public office. They share insights on navigating political marriages, modernizing the Department of Transportation, and debating elite universities. The couple also reflects on their careers in media and their approach to parenting.
stichpunkte: Meeting on MTV's The Real World launched a long-term partnership spanning media and politics.
Raising nine children required 14 years at home, creating stability and mutual career support.
The Department of Transportation is modernizing old aviation technology and implementing AI for scheduling.
Autonomous vehicle regulation requires a single federal standard rather than a hodgepodge of state rules.
Parental concerns about elite universities center on preserving traditional values against radicalization.
A family road trip across America aimed to inspire citizens and promote connection away from screens.

clips.hook: What is the hardest number of kids?
clips.text: The hosts and guests briefly debate the most difficult number of children to raise, agreeing that the jump from zero to one is the toughest.

clips.hook: Getting a first office at age 50
clips.text: Reflecting on career milestones, the guest notes she did not secure her own professional office until turning fifty years old.
The transportation secretary describes replacing outdated radios, radar, and tower switches while air traffic controllers express surprise at the rapid equipment upgrades.

clips.hook: The reality of having children at different ages
clips.text: Reflecting on expanding the family across decades, the speaker notes that raising a baby at age fifty brings much more wisdom but significantly less physical energy.

clips.hook: A presidential negotiation in the Oval Office
clips.text: The transportation secretary recounts how the president directly called a contractor CEO from the Oval Office to slash a contract by two hundred million dollars.

beschreibung: This week on the Katie Miller Podcast, Fox News host Rachel Campos-Duffy and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy sit down for an exclusive joint interview. They share their love story, from meeting on an MTV reality show to raising nine kids, and pull back the curtain on life at the highest levels of media and government. Sean also gets real about how to make travel more family-friendly and what it is really like to have President Trump as his boss.
